content: Hi, I’m Sean Mahdavian. I’ve been working on a Lean 4 formalization project investigating condensed abelian groups as TQFT targets, building on Mathlib’s Sites.Monoidal infrastructure and the LTE. The project includes a sorry-free symmetric monoidal structure on CondensedAb, the first embedding functor from SemiNormedGrp to CondensedAb (bridging two previously disjoint Mathlib components), and a disproof of fullness via counterexample. ~1280 lines, 3 sorries, 0 axioms. Repo: https://github.com/seanm27lol/Liquid-tft-lean-CM4CM-
Could you remove from your repo all the instance : ... := inferInstance and definition recalls from mathlib, so that it's easier to see what's actually new?
https://github.com/seanm27lol/Liquid-tft-lean-CM4CM-/blob/ee5acad86fd9b8a3b9b31d502881b43a9a5e7cea/RequestProject/BanachEmbedding.lean seems to be the (only?) new material?
That file looks like it has some content, although I am none to judge whether said content is interesting. Either way, good job on getting through (some of) the proof!

Thanks Yael! Good point. The inferInstance checks were scaffolding from the development process to confirm what Mathlib already had, I’ll clean those out.
For what’s actually new beyond BanachEmbedding.lean:
∙ BanachEmbedding.lean is the main new material, yes. The embedding semiNormedGrpToCondensedAb, faithfulness proof, the fullness disproof (counterexample: summation on c_0(N,Z)), and SemiNormedGrp.hasFiniteProducts which wasn’t in Mathlib.
∙ Cob2.lean has new definitions: FrobeniusObj and CommFrobeniusObj extending Mon_/Comon_, a combinatorial 2d cobordism category as a quotient type, and trivialFrobenius on the unit object (9 axioms via coherence).
∙ MonoidalViaLocalization.lean is mostly assembling existing pieces, but it documents which pieces to assemble (the Sites.Monoidal path wasn’t obvious to find).
∙ LiquidTQFT.lean has the AbstractTQFT structure and transfer theorem, which are small but new definitions.
I’ll clean up the repo to separate the new material from the Mathlib auditing.
Also thanks on the second part it took a while!

Please be aware that asking for arXiv endorsements in public fora is explicitly against arXiv's terms. I strongly recommend you remove that request from your post; indeed often we delete posts asking for arXiv endorsements simply on that basis.
Oh thank you so much I did not realize that. Sorry!
This topic was moved here from #mathlib4 > Liquid TQFT formalization project + arXiv endorsement by Sean Mahdavian.

When I read https://github.com/seanm27lol/Liquid-tft-lean-CM4CM-/blob/main/RequestProject/MonoidalViaLocalization.lean I only see a summary of work that was done by @Dagur Asgeirsson and myself. (Note also that I have formalized the "direct attack via stalks (question 4)" in #35584).

You’re right – MonoidalViaLocalization.lean is documenting the assembly of your and Dagur’s infrastructure, not new material. The file exists because it took us two sessions to discover that your work already solved the problem (Session 2 was a failed manual construction before we found Sites.Monoidal in Session 3). I should have credited that more clearly in the file header. I’ll update it.
The new material in the project is in BanachEmbedding.lean (the embedding SemiNormedGrp -> CondensedAb, faithfulness proof, fullness disproof, and SemiNormedGrp.hasFiniteProducts) and Cob2.lean (FrobeniusObj/CommFrobeniusObj typeclasses extending Mon_/Comon_, combinatorial 2d cobordism category, trivialFrobenius).
Thanks for the pointer to #35584 – very interesting to see the stalk approach formalized as well.
Updated it, again thanks to all for the feedback. Much appreciated
